name: Update Property Note

pathParams.name: PropertyId
pathParams.description: The property to which the note will be attached

pathParams.name: Id
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the note to update

attributes.name: Body
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the property note. A property note cannot exceed 65,535 characters.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated property note

requestSample:
curl --location --request PATCH 'https://api.appfolio.com/api/v0/properties/57e04805-01c4-4e39-adc9-c74ff9ddc8d9/notes/45e04805-01c4-4e39-adc9-c75ff9ddc8d7' \
     --header 'Authorization: Basic {Auth}' \
     --header 'X-AppFolio-Developer-ID: a965e7d8-a17d-11ec-b909-0242ac120002' \
     --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     --data '{"Body": "This property has a scheduled cleaning service on 11/30/2022 - Updated"}'
